repeated_courses.text: When a course is repeated, the higher grade counts in GPA calculations.

transfer_credit.text: Transfer credit is recorded as CR: it counts for units but is excluded from GPA.

wqb_min_grade.text: A grade of C- or better is required to earn W, Q, or B credit.

grade_order.text: Letter grades from best to worst; grades that earn units (D or better, P, transfer CR). F, FD, N and W earn none.

major_subjects.text: ASSUMPTION (Stuart to verify): the BBA major's subject is BUS only, for 'subject in major' / 'subject outside major'. BUEC is treated as outside the major.

bus_gpa_subjects.text: The BUS GPA (beedie-bus-gpa-*) counts BUS courses only (Stuart, 2026-10-04).

pass_fail_courses.text: Pass/fail courses: a P grade satisfies their requirement. A P satisfies no other letter-grade minimum (Stuart, 2026-10-04).

admission_gated_courses.text: Required for BBA entrants admitted Fall 2022 onward. Earlier admissions: different requirement set; the audit reports these rows as unknown (Stuart, 2026-10-04).

entries.text: This course is only open to approved business administration majors admitted to the faculty in Fall 2022 and onward
This course is only open to approved business administration majors admitted to the faculty through the BBA major - highschool or transfer stream in Fall 2022 and onward

restriction_programs.text: Exact prerequisite restriction texts (prereqs.json) resolved from student.program and admissionTerm; exact string match only. Not listed on purpose: the BUS 201 and BUS 202 texts, which also require a Business Foundation Pathway the student data doesn't record. Any text not listed stays unknown (Stuart, 2026-10-04).

unit_load.text: ASSUMPTION - verify against the calendar: units per study term, min 9 (full time) and max 18. Summer uses the same values for now. Violations are warnings until verified (Stuart, 2026-10-04).
